summary: FDM-printable six-piece Mini-ITX enclosure, 152 x 256 x 252 mm, for a standard Mini-ITX board, AXP120-X67 cooler, inverted dual-slot GPU with 200 mm riser and far-end support, and a rear-inserted standard SFX PSU.

required_interfaces.description: Retain a standard 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard on four approximately 6.35 mm tall cylindrical printed standoffs. Each standoff must be integral to its mounting position and use a kit-generated M3 self-forming hole, so no brass standoff, heat-set insert or separate standoff is required. Three standoffs are fused to enclosure host parts; the lower-front standoff is fused to a detachable printed mount arm that is retained by one underside M3 screw and must remain a separate solid from the base.

With the service side removed, permit side insertion, seating at the support plane, rearward engagement of the standard I/O aperture, access to all four screw axes and removal without trapping the motherboard.
Fit the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope and preserve side-panel intake clearance.

Fit an inverted compact dual-slot GPU, rear 110 mm opening, lower PCIe support beam with approximately 1 mm pass-through gap and 2.4 mm three-sided half-frame. Fuse a far-end U cradle to the removable front panel with 40.8 mm clear inside width, 18 mm contact depth and a support surface 0.8 mm below the 97 mm GPU reference bottom for a soft pad. Removing the front panel must withdraw the cradle without trapping the GPU.
Permit rear straight-line insertion of a 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm SFX PSU with assembly clearance, four 4.2 mm mounting holes at 113 x 51.5 mm spacing and unobstructed driver channels.

Use embedded 15 x 10 x 4 mm magnets with centered screw retention for the designated removable panels, while keeping the rear panel screw-fastened and all retention features outside hardware service envelopes.
Provide one externally accessible power button with an internal cable path to the motherboard header.

assembly_story.installation: Install the detachable lower-front motherboard mount arm on the base with its underside M3 screw. Remove the service side panel; insert the Mini-ITX motherboard from the side while forward of the rear panel, bring it onto the four integral 6.35 mm cylindrical printed standoffs, slide the rear I/O into the aperture and install four M3 screws directly into the printed self-forming holes. Then install the PCIe riser and inverted dual-slot GPU, fit the removable front panel so its integral far-end U support slides beneath and locates the GPU, push the SFX PSU straight in from the rear and complete the six-panel enclosure assembly.
assembly_story.maintenance: Remove the appropriate magnetic side/front panel for routine access. The motherboard screws are intended for normal service rather than high-cycle repeated disassembly; avoid over-tightening. Remove the screw-fastened rear panel only when rear service access is required.
user_access: SFX AC inlet and rear mounting screws
removable side and front service panels

documents.description: Complete printable Mini-ITX enclosure assembly with four integral cylindrical motherboard standoffs, a detachable lower-front motherboard mount arm, SFX rear insertion, inverted dual-slot GPU support and six enclosure panels
